description.narrative: Philippines, Malaria, Pilipinas Shell Foundation, Inc. (PSFI)This program has the following goals: By 2020, to reduce the malaria incidence rate in the Philippines by 80% relative to a 2013 baseline (NMCEP 2014-2020). To increase the number of malaria free provinces from 27 to 50 (NMCEP 2014-2020). The objectives of this program are: To ensure quality malaria services, timely detection of infection and immediate response, and information and evidence to guide malaria elimination (NMCEP 2014-2020). To ensure universal access to reliable diagnosis, highly effective and appropriate treatment and preventive measures (NMCEP 2014-2020). To secure government and non-government financing to sustain malaria control and elimination at all levels (NMCEP 2014-2020). To strengthen governance and human resources capacity at all levels to manage and implement malaria interventions (NMCEP 2014-2020)
